method: Execute the exact six migration statements as a transaction through the Neon connector on an isolated copy. This tests the SQL and rollback behaviour; it is not a production deployment or a run of the complete migration pipeline.

checks.name: Ambiguous existing brief with NULL override flag
checks.outcome: Expected exception before backfill; transaction rolled back

checks.name: Rollback contract
checks.outcome: Column remained nullable with no default and both original NULL values retained

checks.name: Explicit fixture adjudication
checks.outcome: Only the synthetic ambiguous fixture was classified as manual before retry

checks.name: Valid conversion
checks.outcome: NULL with no brief became false; existing true/false flags and brief content preserved

checks.name: Repeat execution
checks.outcome: Successful; same column contract and fixture values
